### 3b Scene renderer (loop body)
One scene at a time (also paces the Veo API): plan attempt -> submit (predictLongRunning) -> poll -> download -> save.
Fallbacks: 429/5xx backoff with jitter -> softened prompt on safety blocks -> retry without images -> next tier (Veo 3.1 -> Fast -> Lite) -> animated still image (Gemini image + ffmpeg) -> report failure.

parameters.content:
## AI Video Factory - Veo 3.1
**Setup (once)**
1. Create credentials: *Header Auth* named **Gemini API Key** (name `x-goog-api-key`, value = your Gemini API key), a **Gmail OAuth2** and a **Google Drive OAuth2** credential, then select them on the nodes.
2. Self-hosted env: `NODES_EXCLUDE=[]`, `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=fs,zlib`, ffmpeg + fonts in the container (see README).
3. Edit global settings in **Init Job** (models, resolution, limits).
4. Optional: set the error workflow in the workflow settings.

### 1 Intake
Form (topic, brief, docs/images/media) -> files saved + text extracted -> Intake Analyst (Gemini) decides if duration/format/etc. are known. If not, an e-mail form asks the missing questions (max 2 rounds).

### 2 Research + Storyboard
Google-Search grounded research -> Creative-Director planner writes the style bible, Veo-ready scene prompts (with dialogue/SFX), safe fallback prompts, reference-image plan. Fallback text model on failure.

### 3 Render
Each scene = one Veo clip, rendered by the sub-workflow with retries, backoff, model-tier fallback, still-image fallback. Prompt-hash cache means revisions only re-render changed scenes.

### 4 Assemble + QA
ffmpeg normalises, stitches, burns captions, loudness-normalises, makes thumbnail + preview. A Gemini QA agent watches the preview and may trigger one automatic fix round.

### 5 Human approval
Preview e-mail + Approve/Needs-changes e-mail. Approved -> Google Drive folder (video, thumbnail, script, storyboard, manifest). Rejected -> feedback form -> targeted re-render (max 2 rounds).
